latestVersion.changelog:
Star Search v8 introduces major changes:
- Switched primary search engine to Sogou with Camofox REST API (returns 10 results, no captcha, high stability).
- Baidu+Camofox is now a backup engine (9 results, occasional captchas).
- 360+Camofox provides additional coverage (6 results, no captcha).
- All engine access is now strictly via Camofox REST API; Hermes browser tools are no longer supported.
- Removed Baidu Qianfan API integration due to API key invalidation.
- Clarified real-world engine statuses and recommended optimal workflows.
